_note: Promises the leader can make while speaking in a debate: after a speech, the pledges for that debate's topic and side are offered. topic: a debate topic id (debates.json), or law_<id> for a bill. side: L or R on the debate's axis. size: big (a headline promise; CONFIG.pledges.maxBig at most) or small. Voters on that side warm to it; the other side cools; speaking or starting a debate for the other side of the same topic (or the same issue, for a big one) breaks it, and those it pleased remember. law: a promise to undo a bill (kept if the bill falls). react: extra groups ({who, amt}, as in events).
